Subject: Channel rev + lead registration ops - draft workflow attached

Hi Diego,

Thanks again for the call this morning — CloudForge is excited about getting a lightweight rev-share channel in place with Redwood. Attached is a first-pass ops workflow (Draft_OPS_Workflow_v1.xlsx) that shows how we envision: lead capture -> qualification -> registration -> deal crediting -> monthly settlement.

Before we lock in commercial terms, we need clarity on two operational items that are blocking our finance and partnerships teams:

- Lead registration eligibility: what validates a CloudForge-originated lead vs inbound that your SDRs touched?
- Commission timing & invoicing cadence: monthly settlement vs quarterly?

Can you loop in whomever owns lead ops on your side and confirm a short timeline? We’d like a one-page ops doc so our legal can spin an SOW.

Cheers,
Emma Liu
Head of Partnerships, CloudForge
emma@cloudforge.com

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Channel rev + lead registration ops - draft workflow attached

Hi Emma — great to hear. Looping in Marissa (Partnerships ops) and Ben (Sales ops) to lay out specific thresholds and the registration flow. Quick answers up-front:

- Lead registration: we require a CloudForge-registered lead form submission OR a HubSpot lead record with the "referred_by=CloudForge" UTM + first-touch contact email that matches your domain. If Redwood SDRs already had an active contact (contacted within 90 days), we treat as disputed and move to manual review.
- Commission bands: standard referral is 8% of recognized revenue for first 12 months; for joint-sourced pipeline (co-sell) we can escalate to 12% if CloudForge brings technical integration and joint GTM (minimum ARR commit $50k).
- Invoicing/settlements: Redwood issues monthly statement of credits and pays partner within 45 days of month-end by ACH or wire.

Action items:
1) Marissa, can you review the attached workflow and mark any operational gaps (registration capture points, required fields, dispute SLA)?
2) Ben, we need the exact HubSpot custom-field names and the CSV template for batch registrations.
3) Emma, once we align we’ll produce a one-page ops & payment schedule for legal to incorporate into the SOW.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.com
T: +1 415-555-0173
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:28:00 -0700

Thanks Diego — quick clarifications from ops perspective:

- Registration fields we must capture (minimum): partner_name, source_medium, source_campaign, referring_contact_email, opportunity_owner, MQL_date, lead_create_ts, first_touch_note.
- Dispute window: 30 days from registration or first recognized revenue, whichever is earlier; default is in favor of partner if submission includes original first-touch email and timestamp.
- Duplicate rule: if the contact exists and has a won opportunity older than 120 days, we’ll treat as non-credit.

I’ll annotate Draft_OPS_Workflow_v1.xlsx with these fields and add a tab for the CSV import template. Planning to surface the CSV format today so Ben can confirm HubSpot field mappings.

-Marissa
